nihilismExplanation.title: Nihilism Coefficient
nihilismExplanation.text: The Nihilism coefficient is used throughout the entire journey. It is made up of three components: Truth, Unity, and Purpose. Each of these components have a value from 0 to 1. The overall Nihilism Coefficient is calculated by taking the average of these components. The higher the value of a component, the more the Monster has abandoned that specific value. The higher the Nihilism Coefficient, the closer the Monster is to psychological Nihilism. After each quote and analysis, there is a detailed breakdown of how that analysis impacts the Nihilism Coefficient.

ending.title: The Monster’s Journey Has Ended
ending.text: The Monster has reached psychological nihilism
